title: Lock the occupancy decision in writing BEFORE the transfer
body: Draft a one-page household policy: which path triggers under which conditions (cash size, market level, occupancy intent). Prevents reverse-engineering the answer from a single projection.

title: Obtain independent valuations and rent comps
body: Date-of-death appraisal (for basis and Prop 19), plus three rent comparables for Property A. Until then every 'rent' number on this site is a floor.

title: Insurance audit for both properties
body: Replace the ~$1,500 household guesses with quoted premiums (HO-3 for A; DP-3/landlord for B). Check CDI ZIP-level report for both property ZIPs (internal) context.

title: Estate liquidity plan if the estate may exceed the exclusion
body: Identify cash/liquid assets covering potential 40% tax within 9 months; discuss §6166 and life-insurance options with counsel.

title: Sign an investment policy statement for the proceeds now
body: Write the allocation, phasing rules (24–36-month Treasury park), rebalancing, and drawdown limits BEFORE any money arrives.

title: Annual re-run calendar
body: Every January: re-run this model; every February 16: check BOE's new Prop 19 cap; every November: check ballot measures; annually verify insurance and rents.

title: Add a 'Flagged for Review' triage routine
body: When any flagged item is resolved (e.g., TRA found, comps obtained), update research/SOURCES.md, re-run model/build_model.py, and redeploy.

title: Pre-agree the black-swan rule
body: Decide now: if markets fall >30% within 12 months of selling, do we pause the phase-in, speed it up, or hold to schedule? Write it down.

title: Extend the model to monthly granularity
body: Annual data smooths crashes; monthly series would sharpen the 1929/2008 entry tests.

title: Add per-TRA lookup helper
body: Once the household shares a TRA number (not the address), pin the published rate into the data table with the county source link.
